capabilities: Run analytical SQL on local Parquet files via DuckDB WASM
Render query results as inline HTML tables
Draw charts with Observable Plot marks (bar, line, area, box, waffle)
Configure charts with per-block directives and frontmatter plot defaults
Export notes to PDF with SVG charts that keep explicit dimensions
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js fs for Parquet I/O); installable via BRAT; ships with a companion Claude Code skill for generating reports from parquet files.
motivation: The author wanted a single executable document where narrative, queries, and charts live inline, inspired by Evidence.dev's philosophy that SQL and documents belong together.
problem: Data-driven reports force writers to switch to notebooks or dashboard tools, then export and re-link chart images every time the data changes.

relations.evidence: QuackBlocks is inspired by Evidence.dev — the markdown-based BI framework
Inline charts — visualize with Observable Plot (bar, line, area, dot, heatmap, box, waffle, and more)
DuckDB WASM — run analytical SQL directly inside Obsidian, no external server

summary: Executable SQL code blocks powered by DuckDB WASM that query local Parquet files and render inline tables and Observable Plot charts.
